error_codes.description: Standardized error codes for HyperQL exceptions. Format [XYYY]. All errors return a standardized JSON object.

definitions.name: Syntax Error
definitions.desc: Unexpected token

definitions.name: Namespace Collision
definitions.desc: Two files in the same namespace define the same name

definitions.name: Unresolved Import
definitions.desc: IMPORT references a namespace or name that does not exist

definitions.name: Circular Import
definitions.desc: Import chain creates a circular dependency

definitions.name: Missing Purity Decorator
definitions.desc: DEFINE FUNCTION has no decorator

definitions.name: Const Reassignment
definitions.desc: Assignment statement targets a CONST binding.

definitions.name: Missing Return Path
definitions.desc: UDF body has no code path that reaches a RETURN.

definitions.name: Inline Field Type Declaration
definitions.desc: Type body contains forbidden inline type annotation.

definitions.name: Undefined Field Reference
definitions.desc: Type body references field with no matching DEFINE FIELD.

definitions.name: Invalid Decorator Expression
definitions.desc: A structural constraint decorator references more than one field or contains an expression not valid in single-field context.

definitions.name: Non-Exhaustive Union Match
definitions.desc: MATCH expression over a union type does not cover all variants and has no wildcard catch-all.

definitions.name: Illegal Decorator Placement
definitions.desc: @deferred is not permitted on role ALLOWS constraint blocks; use it only on named constraints in node or edge constraint blocks.

definitions.name: Type Mismatch
definitions.desc: Expected X, got Y

definitions.name: Unresolvable Enum Shorthand
definitions.desc: Shorthand (.Id) could not be resolved during type-checking.

definitions.name: Illegal Abstract Instantiation in Schema Context
definitions.desc: Schema-level logic incorrectly assumes an abstract type is concrete.

definitions.name: Stale QueryPlan
definitions.desc: A prepared statement's plan failed revalidation after a schema ALTER affected one of its dependency SchemaIds. Resolution: Re-prepare the statement.

definitions.name: Parameter Type Mismatch
definitions.desc: Supplied value doesn't match resolved parameter type.

definitions.name: Parameter Type Ambiguous
definitions.desc: $param in position where type cannot be inferred; annotation required.

definitions.name: Stale Schema Reference
definitions.desc: A schema construct referenced by display: or a QueryPlan was dropped and its SchemaId retired.

definitions.name: Undefined Role ALLOWS Type
definitions.desc: Edge role references a type that is not defined.

definitions.name: Role Constraint Field Not Found
definitions.desc: Constraint in role ALLOWS block references a field not present on the allowed type.

definitions.name: Unified Role Constraint Field Mismatch
definitions.desc: Constraint block follows a multi-type ALLOWS clause but a referenced field does not exist on all allowed types.

definitions.name: Trait Instantiation
definitions.desc: Direct instantiation of a Trait via CREATE NODE. Replaces [4010] for the Trait case.

definitions.name: Circular View Reference
definitions.desc: View definition creates a circular dependency with another view.

definitions.name: View Parameter Type Ambiguous
definitions.desc: Parameter in view definition cannot have its type inferred. Annotation required.

definitions.name: Invalid Union Usage
definitions.desc: Union type used in a position where it is not permitted (node body, edge body, field type, etc.)

definitions.name: Reserved Identifier
definitions.desc: _id is a reserved identifier and cannot be used as a field name.

definitions.name: Duplicate Metadata Key
definitions.desc: Metadata key 'display' or 'constraints' appears more than once in the type metadata block.

definitions.name: Invalid Display Field Reference
definitions.desc: Field name in display: declaration does not match any field in the type body.

definitions.name: Ambiguous Inherited Display Field
definitions.desc: Type inherits conflicting display: declarations from multiple parents and must declare its own.

definitions.name: Ambiguous Function Call
definitions.desc: Multiple function signatures match, cannot resolve

definitions.name: Computed Field Mutation
definitions.message: Field '$field' is @computed and cannot be assigned.
suggestions: Remove the field from the CREATE, SET, or MERGE clause.
To change the computed value, modify the underlying fields the expression depends on.

definitions.name: Purity Violation
definitions.desc: Body or transitive call graph exceeds declared decorator [Decision 12].

definitions.name: Illegal Constraint Call
definitions.desc: @readonly or @nondeterministic UDF used in { constraints: {...} }

definitions.name: Illegal Aggregate Decorator
definitions.desc: DEFINE AGGREGATE FUNCTION marked non-@pure

definitions.name: Partial Enum Values
definitions.desc: Valued enum has mix of assigned and unassigned constants

definitions.name: Duplicate Enum Value
definitions.desc: Two constants share the same backing value

definitions.name: Illegal Flags Value
definitions.desc: <FLAGS> constant has explicit = value assignment

definitions.name: Flags Ceiling Exceeded
definitions.desc: <FLAGS> enum exceeds 64 constants

definitions.name: Decimal Literal Required
definitions.desc: <DECIMAL> constant assigned without 'd' suffix

definitions.name: Unknown Enum Backing Type
definitions.desc: <TYPE> parameter is not a permitted backing type

definitions.name: Invalid Default Expression
definitions.desc: Default uses a forbidden function

definitions.name: Default Type Mismatch
definitions.desc: Default expression return type does not match field type

definitions.name: @materialized on Expression Field
definitions.desc: @materialized is only valid on @computed(TRAVERSE) fields. Applying it to @computed(EXPRESSION) fields is forbidden.

definitions.name: Retired
definitions.desc: Code retired in v0.20 (formerly @materialized/@volatile conflict on Expression).

definitions.name: Computed Field Name Collision
definitions.desc: @computed entry name matches an existing global field.

definitions.name: Invalid Cardinality Expression
definitions.desc: Malformed cardinality bounds

definitions.name: Unique Constraint Violated
definitions.desc: Value already exists

definitions.name: Role Uniqueness Constraint Required
definitions.desc: Role-based MERGE requires @unique constraint

definitions.name: Role Cardinality Violated
definitions.desc: Node count for role is outside declared bounds.

definitions.name: Missing Required Field
definitions.desc: Non-nullable field with no default omitted from CREATE

definitions.name: Max Constraints Exceeded
definitions.desc: Too many constraints per node

definitions.name: Expression Depth Exceeded
definitions.desc: Constraint expression too complex

definitions.name: Constraint Timeout
definitions.desc: Evaluation took too long

definitions.name: Read-Only Field Violation
definitions.desc: Attempt to modify a field which is immutable (e.g., _id or @readonly field after creation).

definitions.name: Materialized Property Update Failed
definitions.desc: @materialized property recomputation failed

definitions.name: Migration Validation Failed
definitions.desc: Existing data violates new constraint

definitions.name: Schema Evolution Conflict
definitions.desc: Concurrent schema modifications conflict

definitions.name: Circular Dependency
definitions.desc: Constraint cycle detected (use @deferred)

definitions.name: Referential Integrity Violation
definitions.message: Cannot delete a node that has active edge connections or is referenced by a non-nullable Node<T> or List<Node<T>> field.
suggestions: Use DETACH DELETE to remove all edge connections before deletion.
Ensure no non-nullable Node<T> fields reference this node before deletion.
Query referencing fields: MATCH (n) WHERE n.someNodeField = $id RETURN n;

definitions.name: Retired
definitions.desc: Code retired in v0.20 (formerly Abstract Node Instantiation). Superseded by [2032] for the Trait case.

definitions.name: Abstract Edge Instantiation
definitions.desc: createEdge() called with an abstract EdgeHandle.

definitions.name: Invalid Parameter Value
definitions.desc: Parameter value violates constraints.

definitions.name: Subquery Timeout
definitions.desc: @computed(TRAVERSE) exceeded timeout limit.

definitions.name: Variable Not Found
definitions.desc: Variable used before declaration

definitions.name: Immutable Violation
definitions.desc: Reassignment of a CONST variable

definitions.name: Recursion Limit Exceeded
definitions.desc: Call stack exceeded max_recursion_depth

definitions.name: Loop Limit Exceeded
definitions.desc: Iteration count exceeded max_loop_iterations

definitions.name: UDF Runtime Error
definitions.desc: UDF threw an unhandled error in constraint context -> maps to [3015]

definitions.name: Deadlock Victim
definitions.message: Transaction aborted: selected as deadlock victim.
suggestions: Reorder operations to acquire locks in a consistent global order.
Keep transactions short to reduce deadlock probability.

definitions.name: Transaction Aborted
definitions.desc: Concurrent modification conflict

definitions.name: Prepared Statement Not Found
definitions.desc: Referenced prepared statement doesn't exist

definitions.name: Too Many Prepared Statements
definitions.desc: Session prepared statement limit exceeded. DROP unused statements before preparing new ones.

definitions.name: Index Corruption
definitions.desc: Index structure corrupted, rebuild required

definitions.name: Materialized View Maintenance Failed
definitions.desc: Incremental update failed

definitions.name: Materialized View Stale
definitions.desc: View marked stale; falls back to partition scan.

definitions.name: Permission Denied
definitions.desc: Operation requires a permission the authenticated user does not hold.

definitions.name: Access Policy Filtered
definitions.desc: Internal. Access policy caused node/edge to be excluded. Not surfaced to the querying user.

definitions.name: User Not Found
definitions.desc: Referenced user does not exist.

definitions.name: Access Role Not Found
definitions.desc: Referenced access role does not exist.

warnings.name: Silent Subtype Exclusion
warnings.desc: One or more subtypes were excluded from a polymorphic MATCH due to permission boundaries. Enable STRICT_PERMISSIONS to convert to hard errors.

warnings.name: Silent Role Traversal Exclusion
warnings.desc: One or more role-bound nodes were excluded from traversal results due to permission boundaries. Enable STRICT_PERMISSIONS to convert to hard errors.

warnings.name: Inline Field Declaration (Pre-v0.19)
warnings.desc: v0.19 requires extraction to DEFINE FIELD.

warnings.name: Union Column Alias Mismatch
warnings.desc: UNION branches provide different aliases for the same column position. Left branch alias is used in the output.

warnings.name: Computed property in WHERE
warnings.desc: Executes subquery for each scanned row

warnings.name: Dynamic Traversal Materialization
warnings.desc: Emitted in two conditions: (1) A CROSS_TYPE query falls back to a full cross-partition scan because no eligible materialized view covers the query predicate, or an eligible view is stale. (2) A @computed(TRAVERSE) @materialized field uses a variable-depth traversal pattern for which static write-trigger derivation is incomplete, meaning freshness cannot be guaranteed.

warnings.name: Unindexed Node<T> Reverse Traversal
warnings.desc: A query performs a reverse lookup on a Node<T> field that is not @indexed. This forces a scan of all partitions containing that field. [Decision 16]

warnings.name: Retired
warnings.desc: Code retired in v0.20 alongside the removal of the @cold decorator.

dual_serialization_format.purpose: Optimized on-disk storage for internal runtime access.

queryplan_persistence.lifecycle: Plans have states: valid, invalid (produced error [2023]), or pending (during ALTER transaction).
revalidation_on_alter: 2. Engine locates all stored plans referencing affected handles.
3. Each plan is revalidated synchronously against the new schema.
4. Plans failing revalidation are marked 'invalid'; others remain 'valid'.
5. ALTER does not commit until all revalidation is complete.

6. If the ALTER itself is rolled back (e.g. due to a migration validation failure [3030]), all plan validity states are restored to their pre-ALTER values. No plan is left in 'invalid' state as a result of an ALTER that did not commit.

HandleAliases.EdgeHandle: Alias for SchemaId identifying an edge type.
HandleAliases.FieldHandle: Alias for SchemaId identifying a field definition.
HandleAliases.TraitHandle: Alias for SchemaId identifying a trait definition.

node_constraints.query: DEFINE NODE BankAccount { account_number, balance, overdraft_limit } { constraints: { valid_balance: balance >= -overdraft_limit, has_account_number: account_number != "", positive_overdraft: overdraft_limit >= 0 } };

usage.create: CREATE EDGE f:Friendship { friend => alice, friend => bob };
usage.query: MATCH (p:Person { name: "Alice" }), (f:Friendship { friend => p }) RETURN f.friend AS all_friends;

subqueries.query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS ( MATCH (c:Commute {driver => p}) WHERE c.Date > "2025-01-01" ) RETURN p.Name;

mutations.query: MERGE (e:Enrollment { student => s, course => c }) ON CREATE SET e.Date = NOW();

global_search.query: MATCH (n) CROSS_TYPE WHERE n.LastName = 'Smith' RETURN n, TYPE(n);

indexing.query: DEFINE INDEX NameIndex ON Person (LastName, FirstName);

MATCH (p:Person)
USE INDEX DescriptionFulltext
WHERE p.Description MATCHES "avatar.*fire"
RETURN p;

pattern_matching.query:
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.Name LIKE "A%"
  AND p.Email ILIKE "%@gmail.com"
  AND p.Phone MATCHES "^\\d{3}-\\d{3}-\\d{4}$"
RETURN p;

null_handling.query:
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE p.MiddleName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.Nickname != null
RETURN p.Name, COALESCE(p.Nickname, p.FirstName) AS display_name;

MATCH (p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Person)-[:Friendship]-(p)
WHERE f IS NOT NULL
RETURN p.Name, COLLECT(f.Name) AS friends;

pagination_and_ordering.query:
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.Name, p.Age, p.Department
ORDER BY p.Department ASC, p.Age DESC
SKIP 20
LIMIT 10;

MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN DISTINCT p.Department, AVG(p.Salary) AS avg_sal
GROUP BY p.Department
ORDER BY avg_sal DESC
LIMIT 5;

window_functions.query:
MATCH (s:Sale)
RETURN s.Date, s.Product, s.Amount,
  SUM(s.Amount) OVER (ORDER BY s.Date) AS running_total,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.Product ORDER BY s.Amount DESC) AS product_rank;

MATCH (m:MonthlyMetric)
RETURN m.Month, m.Revenue,
  LAG(m.Revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.Month) AS prev_month,
  (m.Revenue - LAG(m.Revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.Month)) / 
    LAG(m.Revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY m.Month) * 100 AS growth_pct;

graph_algorithms.query:
WITH PAGERANK(Person, Follows) AS scores
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN [ p.Name, scores[p] AS influence ]
ORDER BY influence DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH PAGERANK(Person, Follows, damping: 0.90, max_iterations: 50) AS scores
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN [ p.Name, scores[p] AS influence ]
ORDER BY influence DESC;

WITH LOUVAIN(User, Collaboration) AS communities
MATCH (u:User)
RETURN [
  communities[u]  AS community_id,
  COUNT(u)        AS members,
  COLLECT(u.Name) AS member_names
]
GROUP BY communities[u]
ORDER BY members DESC;

WITH BETWEENNESS_CENTRALITY(Server, Connection) AS scores
MATCH (s:Server)
WHERE scores[s] > 0.7
RETURN [ s.Name, scores[s] AS bottleneck_score ]
ORDER BY bottleneck_score DESC;

MATCH (me:User { Id: $user_id }), (other:User)
WHERE other.Id != me.Id
  AND JACCARD_SIMILARITY(me, other, Interests) > 0.3
RETURN [ other.Name, JACCARD_SIMILARITY(me, other, Interests) AS similarity ]
ORDER BY similarity DESC;

complex_workflows.query:
-- Stage 1: Find active users
MATCH (u:User)
WHERE u.LastLogin > "2025-01-01"
WITH u

/* Stage 2: Calculate their activity scores
WITH u, 
  (MATCH (u)-[:Posted]->(p:Post) RETURN COUNT(p)) AS post_count,
  (MATCH (u)-[:Liked]->(l) RETURN COUNT(l)) AS like_count
WITH u, post_count, like_count,
  post_count * 2 + like_count AS activity_score

-- Stage 3: Rank and filter
WITH u, activity_score,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY activity_score DESC) AS rank
WHERE rank <= 100

RETURN u.Name, activity_score, rank
ORDER BY rank;

-- Find similar users based on shared interests
MATCH (me:User {Id: $user_id})
MATCH (other:User)
WHERE other.Id != me.Id
  AND JACCARD_SIMILARITY(me, other, Interests) > 0.3
WITH other, JACCARD_SIMILARITY(me, other, Interests) AS similarity

/* Get items they liked that I haven't
MATCH (other)-[:Liked]->(item:Item)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (MATCH (me)-[:Liked]->(item))

-- Aggregate and rank recommendations
WITH item, SUM(similarity) AS total_similarity, COUNT(other) AS recommender_count
WHERE recommender_count >= 3
RETURN item.Name, total_similarity, recommender_count
ORDER BY total_similarity DESC
LIMIT 20;

query_optimization.reason: Single query with aggregation eliminates round trips
Enables reuse, prevents type drift, required by EXTENDS
Trades write cost for read performance

query_optimization.better: DEFINE FIELD email: String @unique @index; /* Then same query uses index
query_optimization.reason: Filtered scans are O(n), indexed lookups are O(log n)

query_optimization.anti_pattern: MATCH (p:Person)-[:Friend]-(f) WITH p, COLLECT(f) AS friends WHERE p.age > 30 RETURN p, friends;
query_optimization.better: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age > 30 MATCH (p)-[:Friend]-(f) RETURN p, COLLECT(f) AS friends;

transaction_management.reason: Reduces commit overhead, enables atomic operations
transaction_management.example: BEGIN; CREATE NODE [ p1:Person {...}, p2:Person {...} ]; COMMIT;

transaction_management.reason: Query plan caching, prevents injection, type safety
transaction_management.example: PREPARE stmt AS MATCH (p:Person { id: $id }) RETURN p;

transaction_management.reason: Long transactions hold locks, blocking other operations

data_modeling.reason: Captures multi-party relationships and relationship properties
No identity needed, not queryable as separate entities. Pure value containers with storage locality.
data_modeling.example: DEFINE STRUCT GeoPoint { Latitude, Longitude }; DEFINE NODE Place { Location: Struct<GeoPoint> };

data_modeling.reason: Child needs independent identity, queryability, or edge participation, but the relationship is compositional and directional with no properties of its own.
data_modeling.example: DEFINE FIELD home_address: Node<Address>?; /* Address can be shared, queried, and connected to edges */

data_modeling.pattern: Use Enums for closed value sets
data_modeling.example: DEFINE ENUM Status { ACTIVE, INACTIVE, PENDING };

steps: 1. Define field: DEFINE FIELD middle_name: String?;
2. Add to node: ALTER NODE Person { ADD middle_name };
1. Add new field: ALTER NODE Person { ADD full_name };
2. Copy data: MATCH (p:Person) SET p.full_name = p.name;
3. Drop old field: ALTER NODE Person { DROP name };

scenarios.scenario: Adding a non-null field with default
steps: 1. Define field: DEFINE FIELD status: Enum<Status>;
2. Migrate with default: ALTER NODE Person { ADD status} DEFAULTS { status: Status.ACTIVE };
3. All existing rows get default value
scenarios.notes: Requires default value for existing data

scenarios.scenario: Adding a constraint to existing type
steps: 1. Validate first: VALIDATE MIGRATION Person WITH { constraints: { valid_age: age >= 0 AND age <= 150 } };
2. Review violations in validation report
3. Fix violating data: UPDATE (p:Person) WHERE p.age < 0 OR p.age > 150 SET p.age = null;
4. Apply constraint: ALTER NODE Person { ADD CONSTRAINT valid_age: age >= 0 AND age <= 150 };
scenarios.notes: All existing data must satisfy new constraint or ALTER fails

steps: 1. Define new type: DEFINE NODE Employee EXTENDS Person { employee_id, hire_date };
2. Migrate subset: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.is_employee MIGRATE p TO Employee MAP { DROP [is_employee] };
3. Original Person nodes remain, matching nodes become Employee
1. Define combined edge: DEFINE EDGE Communication EXTENDS [Email, PhoneCall] { medium: Enum<Medium> };
2. Migrate Email: MATCH (e:Email) MIGRATE e TO Communication DEFAULTS { medium: Medium.EMAIL };
3. Migrate PhoneCall: MATCH (p:PhoneCall) MIGRATE p TO Communication DEFAULTS { medium: Medium.PHONE };
scenarios.notes: Use discriminator field to preserve original type info. Communication inherits all roles from Email and PhoneCall via EXTENDS. Localized roles are merged into the subtype's role set.

steps: 1. VALIDATE MIGRATION - Preview impact without changes
2. Review validation report - Check for violations
3. Fix violating data - Update or delete as appropriate
4. Re-validate - Confirm all issues resolved
5. Apply migration - ALTER or MIGRATE
6. Verify - Query sample data to confirm

major_features: Node<T> Composition Type: First-class identity-based composition resolving the gap between Struct-composition and edge-association.
Fully localized roles: ALLOWS, constraints, and names moved to edge scope. DEFINE ROLE removed.
ABSTRACT NODE removed. Traits promoted to first-class graph participants: queryable, valid in role ALLOWS, constraint-bearing, never instantiated.
Anonymous constraints removed. All constraints must be named.
Field-level structural constraint decorators added: @min, @max, @minlength, @maxlength, @pattern, @precision.
@volatile removed.
@cold removed.
Per-file STRICT_MODE removed. STRICT_PERMISSIONS unaffected.
Persistent prepared statements removed. Session-scoped only.
IF NOT EXISTS guard added to all definition statements.
DEFINE VIEW: non-materialized named query fragments, parameterizable, composable, inline-expanded at plan time.
DEFINE UNION: sum/tagged union types for UDF return values with exhaustive pattern matching.
FLAGS enum retained.
Multiple inheritance via EXTENDS retained.
Structs retained as globally-defined value types with inline storage guarantees. Distinct from Traits.
Block comment syntax /* */ formally specified as the only supported comment form. Line comments (//) are not supported. Prior versions left comment syntax implementation-defined.
The Four-Concept Model: Define, Plan, Run, Begin/Commit [Decision 14].
Mandatory global DEFINE FIELD: all type bodies reference fields by name only [1052].
Security Model: DEFINE ACCESS ROLE, CREATE USER, and fine-grained DEFINE ACCESS POLICY.
Namespace Block Nesting: Block-form DEFINE NAMESPACE may be nested within other block-form namespace declarations to arbitrary depth.
Namespace Permission Inheritance: Downward-cascading grants with DENY as hard ceiling. CASCADE / NO CASCADE modifiers. STRICT_PERMISSIONS mode for fail-loud behavior.

Permission Resolution Rules for Inherited Types: Partition authority governs instance data access. Schema dependency and permission dependency are formally separated. Polymorphic subtype visibility and role traversal boundary rules defined.
SHOW EFFECTIVE PERMISSIONS: Introspection command returning fully resolved permission set for a user against a namespace.
UDAF Formal Specification: Mandatory STATE, ACCUMULATE, and FINALIZE clauses for DEFINE AGGREGATE FUNCTION.
HAVING Clause: Post-aggregation filtering for GROUP BY results.
Prepared Statement Lifecycle: Session-scoped and persistent statements with synchronous revalidation.
ON ERROR CONTINUE: Formal transaction semantics with TransactionResult and StatementError types.
Query-Level Graph Algorithm Canonical Form: Positional (Node, Edge) followed by keyword options.
Universal Schema IDs: every schema construct receives a stable UUID v7 at definition time.
Universal Instance IDs: every node and edge instance exposes a built-in virtual field `_id` (UUID v7).
Per-type `display:` metadata: explicit per-type declaration of the canonical display label, replacing @display decorator.
Scalar Similarity Built-ins: JACCARD_SIMILARITY and COSINE_SIMILARITY for point-pair comparisons.
UNION Type Compatibility: Formal unification rules for Int/Float, nullability, and abstract parents.
Tiered Normative Storage Semantics: Observable behavior requirements for all compliant engines.
Unified Performance Warnings: Redesigned [WARN-PERF-004] for Dynamic Traversal Materialization.
Synchronous QueryPlan revalidation on schema ALTER [Decision 10].
New Error Codes: [4001] Connected Node Delete, [2040] Computed mutation, [5001] Deadlock victim, [9010] Permission denied.
Correction of error [2022] to permit abstract types in role ALLOWS lists.
Introspection updates: ExplainConstraintResult, AnalyzeConstraintResult, and array-based NodeTypeInfo.extends.
Normative storage architecture specification (Data-Oriented Design)
Hybrid column/row storage model: fixed-width fields column-oriented, variable-width in separate heap
Struct inline storage guarantee: no pointer indirection for embedded Struct fields
Null bitmap representation: O(1) null checks via per-partition bit vector
MANY role storage model: @ordered → dynamic array, @unordered → open-addressing hash set
Edge dual-storage model: edge partition (column store) + role index tables (sorted node_id/edge_id pairs)
Vector<N> SIMD alignment: 16/32-byte aligned, Struct-of-Arrays layout within partition
@cold decorator: secondary-partition placement for large infrequently-accessed fields
@materialized promoted to strongly preferred for @computed(TRAVERSE) in production schemas
DEFINE MATERIALIZED VIEW: dedicated cross-type indexed partition for CROSS_TYPE queries
Typed Enum variants: <INT>, <DECIMAL>, <STRING>, <FLAGS>
FLAGS enum with uN backing type optimization and byte-boundary migration model
Enum backing values explicitly prohibited as arithmetic operands across all typed variants
Unit conversion canonical pattern: MassUnit node type with @readonly to_base_factor and @pure UDFs
Field DEFAULT clause for write-time default values (global field definitions)
Node-level DEFAULT override: per-type default that overrides global field default
Edge field DEFAULT clause: DEFAULT on inline edge field definitions
Three-level default resolution order: explicit > node/edge override > global > null > error
